description: Bubbleglam is a return to bubblegum pop and kitschy glam looks with a dash of classic 90s cynicism. The movement was influenced by Club Kids , the kitschy resurgence of 1970s glam rock , and drag fashion from the mid-late 1990s. Excessive makeup, fur or faux fur in vibrant hues, bubbles, vivid colors and hues overall, miniskirts, baby doll dresses, velvet, silk, plush, colorful interior design, occasionally incorporating kitschy patterns like animal prints, and "high school vernacular" attire were all featured [ 1 ] . The term was coined by Evan Collins in 2023.
